title: Small but Fair! Fairness for Multimodal Human-Human and Robot-Human Mental Wellbeing Coaching

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating machine learning fairness using Equal Accuracy (EA) and Disparate Impact (DI) metrics on positive affect classification models to compare the performance gap and positive outcome ratios between different gender groups.
